goal: Return a descriptive error instead of crashing transaction creation when mempool cluster limits are hit
Prevents a cryptic internal error when wallet users spend unconfirmed outputs in very large clusters
agreement: Objections resolved, but nobody has formally endorsed the PR yet
Interface objections on return types and error propagation resolved (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it replaces an uncaught exception crash over RPC with a clean user-facing error
Affects the rare edge case of spending unconfirmed outputs in mempool clusters over 500 transactions
